_comment: saltay-kokpit hook block. scripts/install.sh merges this into ~/.claude/settings.json and replaces __CLAUDE_HOME__ with the real path (e.g. /c/Users/you/.claude). Paths are quoted so a home folder with spaces works. All commands run under bash — on Windows that is Git Bash, which Claude Code already requires. Commands an older release registered and this one replaces are listed in settings.remove.json; the optional env block lives in settings.env.json (install.sh --disable-background-tasks).
